items.q: What are the seven coworker needs?
items.a: **Brain, computer, playbooks, tools, credentials, house rules, schedule**.
A **sandbox** where the agent saves artifacts and iterates.
**Injected/rotated by a proxy**—not baked into the agent.
**Deterministic hooks/approvals** for what the agent may do alone.

items.q: What turns a chatbot into a coworker?
items.a: **Triggers/schedule** plus its own computer, skills and tools—so you can leave and come back.
